jobs.1f1b94b36948: The word " and" joining two adjectives or participles ("quick and dirty", "reliable and sensitive"); also " it" right after found/seen/find ("I found it").
jobs.d7f910b9613d: Word right after an adjective or "and" in a predicate or list of qualities ("heavy and annoying", "is difficult", "and low power"); function words after a descriptive adjective, in technical/legal prose.
jobs.9990d44b99b5: First sub-word piece of a rare name or identifier split into pieces ("Syn|EditMarkup", "et|htool", "Ge|ylang", "tw|ink"), at the fragment right after a space or dot.
jobs.a4abc55463dc: unclear: a newline, hyphen or bracket token at a structural boundary, such as the newline between lines of code or math Q&A answers, or the minus sign starting an answer.
jobs.e44acaaf736d: An opening quote mark or opening parenthesis starting a quoted phrase or parenthetical citation, mainly in legal text ("to ⟦"⟧promote", "⟦(⟧citing ..."); also indent before a poem line.
jobs.5059952d07fa: The word right after "and" or a verb in a sequence of steps or items, especially " then" ("melted and then"), also " to", " into", "Moreover", in scientific prose.
jobs.58856649bd3c: A sentence-ending period (or ").") right after a citation, page number, or closing factual clause, in legal or scientific text, just before the next sentence begins.
jobs.074366de8723: A question mark ending a short maths question ("rounded to 5 decimal places?", "is a multiple of 62?"); weaker on the first token of a code comment or license header (" *", "#").
jobs.d1a9ae928194: A comma after an adjective, noun or number inside a list or thousands group ("over 2,000", "discrete, periodic"), or " way" after "find a"/"some".
jobs.b91985d06155: The <|endoftext|> token that ends one document and starts the next, after the last line of any text or code.
jobs.1fb779d3d7fe: unclear: the second token of a two-token phrase after a verb or title, such as " the" in "What are the prime factors", or "."/"Ct" inside U.S. court citations (S.Ct.).
jobs.349f1bab5af8: The word "be" (or "been") right after a modal or passive trigger such as can, could not, yet to, needs to ("can be seen", "yet to be seen").
jobs.bf4b52c06c54: The second or later word of a capitalised title of a song, band, album, book or heading ("At ⟦The⟧ Drive In", "Rage ⟦Against⟧ the Machine", "Here We ⟦Are⟧").
jobs.37ded0356ab3: The <|endoftext|> token at a document break, usually after the last sentence of an abstract or answer; also " advance" in "Thanks in advance".
jobs.4cebb0ff8cd2: A short code or markup token mid-identifier, after a path or keyword ("django.⟦contrib⟧", "\\⟦right⟧", "android:⟦orientation⟧", "node_⟦modules⟧"), or a colon in "Let $X ⟦:⟧".
jobs.d12897e13a56: unclear: a noun or name fragment inside a longer name or noun phrase ("pilot study", "construction contract", "Boy|cie", "Garcia"), usually the next piece after a determiner or capitalised start.
jobs.96e3ac0cbf65: The word " on" after a noun or verb ("person on whose behalf", "rev'd on other grounds", "passengers on her airplane", "on record").
jobs.ff799d48e224: The colon in "Q:" at the start of a Stack Exchange question, right after <|endoftext|>.
jobs.62d01435fa4b: A mid-word fragment of a longer word or name, often in non-English text or archaic prose ("blue-and-⟦sil⟧ver", "dign⟦itos⟧i", "D⟦oyl⟧estown", "Charles ⟦Franklin⟧").
jobs.18d3d5f5db8d: A newline or colon starting a new section: after a heading ("Plot\n", "Synopsis\n"), "Category:" lines, or a question title; also " l" in Italian/Romanian apostrophe words.
jobs.00e906d0a99e: A capital "D" word-start token (" D|ialysis", " D|HA", " D|ancing"), at the start of a sentence or table row, in medical or scientific text.
jobs.50efcd9ef9f2: A word-start fragment "Gu", "gl" or "Co" that begins a longer word or name ("Gu|ess", "gl|immer", "Co|inciding", "Gu|ys", "Co.").
jobs.090854ec5cab: A short first fragment or hyphen at the start of a word or compound (" M|ielestäni", "low⟦-⟧energy", "first⟦-⟧order", " M|BR"), especially capital M after a sentence break.
jobs.1e1256b430bc: A colon or "x" in a short pattern: "public⟦:⟧" in C++ classes, "1⟦:⟧500" dilution ratios, "0⟦x⟧" hex prefixes, or a type colon like "event⟦:⟧".
jobs.2b1bf8aa8a2c: The fragment "light" or "FFIR" inside a word or the start of a word split into pieces ("flash|light", "A|FFIR|M", "Redist|ribution"), plus foreign-language word pieces.
jobs.93550dd5fa82: A mid-word fragment in non-English text, mostly Dutch or Scandinavian (" sp|oorwegen", "we|et", "tilbagef|ørte", "f|ørste"), and odd name or code pieces.
jobs.55762d53aaed: A comma or " and" joining items in a list of variables, numbers or names ("$P_1⟦,⟧ P_2", "Tables I⟦ and⟧ II", "Conceived⟦ and⟧ designed", "Johnson ⟦&⟧ Johnson").
jobs.a5c26fa6d813: The "()" parentheses token directly after a function name in a definition ("void main⟦()⟧", "function doStuff⟦()⟧", "def foo1⟦()⟧").
jobs.56baa9ac35ac: The year number token (or its second half, "18⟦95⟧") in a date in biographical or reference text ("born November 19, 1939", "Breuning, 1962").
jobs.59b5dd5aeccc: A line-start comment or continuation marker in license headers and logs (" *", "//", "~", "--"), also ">" closing an IRC nick like <Riddell>.
